description: One conversation, oldest message first: their DMs and comments, your replies, and what automations sent. Each comment people left carries the comment_id that sprkly_reply_to_comment answers under. dm_window says whether a DM answer is still allowed: Instagram only allows one within 24 hours of their last message. Needs inbox access.
